verdict.rationale:
OpenRouter's docs show that nearly every UI-surfaced capability (model browsing/listing via GET /api/v1/models, key creation/rotation, workspace budgets, provider/data-policy selection, BYOK, chat via API with streaming) has a documented API equivalent, and the docs explicitly note credits can be used 'via the chat room, or create API keys' implying parity between the two paths. However there is no single authoritative statement claiming full UI/API feature parity, and some UI-only surfaces (rankings page, model comparison charts, chat room UI itself) are informational/human-facing rather than programmatically replicable actions, so full parity is inferred rather than explicitly confirmed.

missing for 10: explicit vendor statement of 1:1 UI/API parity, evidence that chat-room-specific UI actions (e.g., saved chat history, model comparisons in UI) have API equivalents.
